NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access lets you pick a profile photo or a screenshot of your boarding pass. The profile photo is uploaded to our server and shown at the visibility you choose; the boarding pass image never leaves your device.
NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to scan the barcode on your boarding pass. The image never leaves your device and is not sent to any server.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your approximate location is read so you can pick the airport you are at in the trip form. Your location never leaves your phone and is not stored.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Your phone's tilt is read for the light effect on the card screen. Motion data never leaves your device and is not stored.
